title: Uniqueness in determining the temporal source factor and the fractional order with an unknown initial value
summary: We consider inverse problems for a time-fractional diffusion equation with a second-order elliptic operator and the homogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition in a bounded domain of $\mathbb R^N$. The initial value is unknown and is not assumed to be zero. The main result concerns the simultaneous determination of the fractional order and the time-dependent source factor from one weighted spatial observation.
